visualCharacteristics.layout: full content width, fixed ~1050px tall on desktop (min(1050px, 85vh) on small screens), black background placeholder
visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: black frame inside a grey section

contentPattern: External interactive app embed: a single cell with a link to the app URL (link text = app name; a bare URL falls back to 'Parker World'). Renders an iframe on allow-listed hosts (www.parker.com) and a dark launch panel with a 'Launch <app name>' button elsewhere. The 'launch' option always shows the launch panel.
